Hello! How can I help you today?

Based on the provided document, the project is an Employee Management System.  It includes modules for employee management (adding, editing, deleting employee details; assigning departments, roles, and managers; viewing employee directories), department and role management (creating, editing, deleting departments; assigning roles to users; mapping reporting hierarchies), attendance and leave management (marking daily attendance, applying for and approving/rejecting leaves), performance and appraisal (recording reviews, assigning goals, viewing history), and notifications and reminders (leave approvals, birthdays/anniversaries, system announcements).  The system uses role-based access control for Admins (full access) and Employees (limited access).  IT support handles system maintenance.
